card.does: Makes a turning shaft slower but stronger, so your robot can climb steeper slopes.
card.gives: Gives: a slower, stronger turning shaft (grey).
card.needs: Needs: a turning shaft (grey) at its input, and a mount (grey) on the chassis (frame).
card.popularMechanics: A bike's low gears work the same way: slower up a hill, but easier to pedal.
card.safetyNote: Real gearboxes have small gears inside, so build with an adult nearby.

failureModes.cardLine: Loose: the housing turns instead of the output shaft.
failureModes.hint: This gearbox is not fixed to the chassis
failureModes.teachingNote: A gearbox turns its output shaft only while its housing is held still on a mount point. Left loose, the housing turns round instead, and the output shaft stays still.

failureModes.cardLine: Nothing turning it: the output shaft stays still.
failureModes.hint: This gearbox needs a turning shaft at its input
failureModes.teachingNote: A gearbox changes the turning it is given and makes none of its own. With no shaft turning its input, its output shaft stays still.
